description: This Swift source file defines utilities for processing shell command invocations, including unwrapping environment invocation wrappers, parsing command tokens, and handling environment variable assignments. It contains enums with static methods to analyze and manipulate command-line argument arrays, especially for environment-related command execution patterns.

methods.name: basenameLower
methods.description: Returns the lowercase basename of a path-like token after trimming whitespace and replacing backslashes with slashes.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Unwraps a command array from environment invocation wrappers, returning the core command if possible.

methods.name: unwrapWithMetadata
methods.description: Unwraps a command array, providing additional metadata on whether modifiers were used in the command.

methods.name: isEnvAssignment
methods.description: Checks if a token is an environment variable assignment based on a regex pattern.

methods.name: unwrapDispatchWrappersForResolution
methods.description: Iteratively unwraps nested 'env' dispatch wrappers in a command array up to a maximum depth.

methods.name: unwrapTransparentEnvInvocation
methods.description: Checks if a command is a transparent environment invocation, returning the command arguments after validation.

methods.name: unwrapTransparentDispatchWrappersForResolution
methods.description: Handles transparent dispatch wrapper unwrapping in nested command arrays.
